provenance.wardRoom: Original room base is preserved. Local restored clean plates sit underneath the original fabric cutouts; original dusk glass pixels receive only runtime exposure changes.
provenance.patientCard: Artist reconstruction of the supplied patient-card reference with live game text and current character portrait layered above.
provenance.innerDoors: Separate generated matte steel inner-door textures; exterior door imagery is preserved.
provenance.approvedAvatarAssets: Existing original registered PNGs and AvatarCore renderer, unchanged.
provenance.ambientTextures: Generated isolated glass residues and wet footprint decals; original room pixels are retained for all fabric and handle front textures.

rendering.outside: Original approved gray dusk view cycles to night and back in 72 seconds. Selective warm-glass relighting preserves dark window texture, frames and foreground mesh when a distant light switches off. No visible exterior fixture on the tenth floor.
rendering.lamp: Three brief warm voltage dips per 61 seconds, first at about 4 seconds; minimum supply 0.60, never off. Room, avatar and cast shadows share the supply.
rendering.groundContact: Derived from the actual composed avatar alpha and heel-to-toe lower contour.
rendering.cabinet: Actual registered trapezoid metal returns, front and separate inner faces; original handle pixels on solid extruded contours, no pull-handle bending. Interior visibility follows the actual leaf angles, fading out before closed hover cleanup so no dark slit or final flash remains.
rendering.state: Existing game save/stat/loadout APIs; Tasks is a read-only placeholder.
rendering.door: The original door face has a true transparent glass aperture. A fixed sharp corridor is seen through it; only glass motion adds slight transient optical smear. No duplicated backdrop is carried by the door.
rendering.contacts: Ordinary windows have only pale hand residue, with no breath/fog patches or writing. The door pane alone carries localized HELP wiped slowly into a thin warm-tinted condensation patch; droplets run after writing ends. One message at a time; effects fade and pause behind dialogs.
rendering.floor: Four damp bare footprints appear successively along a perspective path, then evaporate. Strides and left/right separation are visibly wider; original sole orientation is preserved.
rendering.fabrics: The original curtain is one continuous photo crop up to the fabric attachments; its restored background has a feathered top blend. Robe outer edge excludes baked shadow pixels. Each opaque face and soft cast shadow shares one plane. A shared 54-second cycle moves curtain, then robe, then bag, with quiet gaps and no overlapping movement.
rendering.corridor: Sharp fixed corridor behind the transparent door glass, with independent rare warm voltage dips in a 47-second cycle; minimum supply 0.62, never off.
rendering.tripButton: The original room photo supplies the button and wall pixels, so the fixture follows room exposure exactly. A registered transparent overlay adds only the red-circle hover glow; no scaled opaque wall crop is placed above the room light.

originalHandleCrops.method: Unchanged source pixel crops, SVG contour and runtime 3D projection; no replacement handles drawn.
